name: asteria-investment-office-json
description: Produce the Asteria Investment Office portfolio JSON deliverables (energy-credit trade packages, international equity correlation reviews, active allocation refreshes, fixed-income risk rebalances, and multi-asset committee decisions). Treat the shared Asteria HTTP environment as the authoritative book of record over any local payload, apply the documented policy thresholds, and emit answers that exactly match each task's answer_template (field names, enum value sets, rounding, id ordering). Use this whenever a prompt references Asteria portfolios (PF-*), bonds (BND_*), issuers (ISS_*), indices (IDX_*), opportunity sets, macro signals, or allocation policy.
